hero_subtitle: Experience pristine coastal sunsets aboard luxury yacht charters across Miami, Monaco, Saint-Tropez, Amalfi Coast, London & Dubai.

yachts.name: Solana
yachts.description: Solana, a masterpiece of Majesty's yacht design, features a generous expanse of both deck space and a roomy top deck, making it an ideal choice for accommodating large groups. With a capacity to host up to 60 guests, the yacht offers four well-appointed cabins for their comfort. Its living area is exceptionally spacious, offering plush seating, and it also boasts a separate dining area for added convenience. However, the crowning jewel of this yacht is its expansive flybridge area, complete with abundant seating. The vessel is tastefully adorned and equipped to meet the highest standards, ensuring a truly unforgettable charter experience aboard our magnificent 92-foot Majesty yacht.
yachts.route_details:
2 Hour Trip = Marina - JBR - Atlantis
3 Hour Trip = JBR - Marina Mall - Marina Yacht Club - Dubai Eye - Jumeirah Beach - Atlantis Hotel
4 Hour Trip = Marina - JBR - Atlantis - Burj Al Arab
*all routes are dependent on weather condition

faqs.q: How much does it cost to rent a yacht in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yacht rentals in Dubai start from $ 400/hour for smaller vessels. Premium yachts and superyachts range from $ 1,000 to $ 15,000/hour. All prices include captain, crew, fuel, soft beverages, and safety equipment.

faqs.q: What is included in a Beno yacht charter?
faqs.a: Every Beno yacht charter includes a licensed captain, professional crew, complimentary ice and soft beverages, sound system, fuel, and safety equipment. Premium yachts may also include a flybridge, underwater lighting, and sunbath beds.

faqs.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks on a yacht?
faqs.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and beverages on board. Beno also offers optional catering packages including BBQ setups, birthday cakes, and premium drink packages. Contact us for customization.

faqs.q: What are the popular yacht routes in Dubai?
faqs.a: 2-Hour: Marina → JBR → Atlantis. 3-Hour: JBR → Marina Mall → Dubai Eye → Atlantis Hotel. 4-Hour: Marina → JBR → Atlantis → Burj Al Arab. All routes are weather-dependent and can be customized.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book a yacht in Dubai?
faqs.a: We recommend booking at least 24-48 hours in advance, especially for weekends and holidays. Same-day bookings may be available subject to fleet availability. Use the Beno app for real-time availability.
